description: Minimum required response columns for the public OSE events API. Removing any field from projected_columns MUST be accompanied by removing it here and bumping the version — that makes the change visible in a diff rather than silent. Adding new fields is always safe (additive). Computed fields are those injected by enrichWithPhase() at the handler layer, not projected from the DB SELECT. v1.1.0 (OSE-844/ADR-016): enrichWithPhase now also emits the canonical field names name/startDateISO/venue (mapped from the title/start_date/location columns) so every surface template reads one name per value — see computed_fields. v1.3.0 (OSE-1313): additive starts_at — the canonical UTC start instant (ISO-8601 Z) derived from start_date + start_time in the event's timezone; null for date-only events. v1.4.0 (OSE-2012): additive attendance_mode — 'in_person', 'online' or 'both'; every event from before the field is 'in_person'. An online event has no location, lat, lon or h3_res7. No meeting link is published.
